remarks: Live a coastal lifestyle at Seaside Landing! This luxury Tri-Level END UNIT Townhouse offers 3 to 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths & a 2 car attached garage. Excellent location: easy access to I-95 & the Stamford Metro North Train Station + walk to Cove Island Beach, Chelsea Piers & many local dining establishments. Fully renovated Townhome w new finishes (paint, hardwood flooring, bathroom accents + recessed lighting throughout!). The private entrance offers a spacious balcony perfect for grilling & outdoor dining. Boasting an open floor plan; the living & dining room features slider doors to a 2nd personal balcony. Open Gourmet kitchen w granite countertops, stainless steel appliances & plenty of cabinet space makes storage & entertaining a breeze! Main level w a powder room. 2nd level features a spacious primary bedroom suite w a generously sized walk-in closet + a full bathroom w a marble countertop, dual sinks, walk in glass shower, a deep soaking tub, a 2nd bedrm currently used as a home office + a full hall bathrm along w stackable washer & dryer units. Third level provides a bonus recreation room currently used as a bedrm (make it your own!) + the 3rd bedrm ensuite w a walk-in closet. All bedrms w black out window treatments. LL features a mudroom, access to the 2 car attached garage + addt'l storage (2 areas: a walk-in & crawl space, great for suitcases). Central Air, Natural gas heating. Pet friendly w a little dog run path adjacent to unit & only for #8 use! AVAILABLE NOW.
